title: RAGTruth: A Hallucination Corpus for Developing Trustworthy Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
authors_zh: Cheng Niu、Yuanhao Wu、Juno Zhu、Siliang Xu、KaShun Shum、Randy Zhong、Juntong Song、Tong Zhang
best_for_zh: 需要细粒度事实性、安全性或评审反馈资源的研究者。
one_line: RAGTruth is the paper's released feedback or evaluation resource.
对近 18K RAG 生成回答作实例级、词级和幻觉强度人工标注，直接对应检索证据约束下的生成事实性与细粒度错误定位。
why: It makes a reusable feedback or evaluation surface available for auditing or training reasoning systems.
inclusion_reason: The release exposes fine-grained factuality, safety, or judgment feedback suitable for evaluation or post-training analysis.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Even with retrieved source text, RAG models generate content unsupported by or contradictory to the evidence. Earlier hallucination corpora often use synthetic errors, one task, or response-level labels, limiting training of general detectors that localise spans and represent natural errors across models and temperatures.

RAGTruth collects natural outputs from six LLMs on four RAG tasks and annotates them at instance, word-span, and error-type levels.

RAG 向模型提供来源文本后，回答仍会产生不受证据支持或与证据矛盾的内容。早期幻觉语料多依赖合成错误、单一任务或回答级标签，难以训练能定位具体错误 span 的通用检测器，也无法区分不同模型和温度下的真实生成错误。

RAGTruth 收集六个 LLM 在四类 RAG 任务上的自然输出，并进行实例级、词级和错误类型人工标注。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: RAGTruth contains 17,790 responses generated from 2,965 source instances; 7,664 responses contain hallucinations, with 14,289 annotated spans. Tasks include CNN/DailyMail summarisation, recent-news summarisation, QA, and data-to-text. Records retain source, model, temperature, response, span boundaries and types, quality, and split. The dataset is released under MIT.

RAGTruth 基于 2,965 个 source instance 收集 17,790 份回答，其中 7,664 份含幻觉，共标出 14,289 个 hallucination span。任务覆盖 CNN/DailyMail 摘要、近期新闻摘要、问答和 data-to-text；记录保留 source、模型、temperature、回答、span 起止位置、类型、质量与 split。数据以 MIT 许可开放。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build four tasks: Source instances and retrieval contexts are prepared for two summarisation tasks, QA, and data-to-text.
  1. Sample model responses: Six LLMs generate multiple responses per source at different temperatures, creating a natural error distribution.
  1. Annotate at two levels: Annotators first judge response-level hallucination, then mark word spans, types, and severity with quality review.
  1. Train and mitigate: Small detectors are trained and used to filter or mitigate generation; sources, model versions, temperatures, and guidelines must be fixed.

1. 构建四类任务： 作者整理两类摘要、问答和结构化数据转文本的 source instance 与检索上下文。
  1. 采样多模型回答： 六个 LLM 在不同温度下为每个 source 生成多份回答，形成自然错误分布。
  1. 人工双层标注： 标注者先判断回答是否含幻觉，再定位词级 span、类别和严重程度，并经过质量复核。
  1. 训练与缓解： 作者训练小型检测模型，并用检测结果过滤或修正生成；复现需固定 source、模型版本、温度和标注规范。

title: Evidence
证据
html: A small language model fine-tuned on RAGTruth performs competitively with prompt-based GPT-4 for hallucination detection, showing that high-quality span supervision can replace an expensive online judge. Connecting the detector to generation also reduces hallucinations. This supports dataset utility across six contemporary models and four tasks, but does not establish transfer to newer models, agentic RAG, or multimodal retrieval.
论文发现，在 RAGTruth 上微调的小型语言模型可达到与 prompt-based GPT-4 竞争的幻觉检测表现，说明高质量 span 监督能替代昂贵在线 Judge；将检测器接入生成流程还能降低幻觉。该结果覆盖六个 2023 年前后模型与四类任务，支持数据效用，但不能证明对更新模型、Agent RAG 或多模态检索同样有效。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier RAG factuality data often provide only answer-level labels or inject artificial errors. RAGTruth annotates naturally occurring errors from several real LLMs under evidence constraints and provides response labels plus word spans, types, and severity. The novelty is dense human supervision of natural cross-task errors rather than a new retrieval architecture.
既有 RAG 事实性数据通常只有最终答案标签，或人为注入错误。RAGTruth 直接标注多个真实 LLM 在证据约束下自然产生的错误，并同时提供回答级标签和词级 span、类型与强度。新意是跨任务自然错误的高密度人工监督，而不是新检索架构。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Limitation 1: Models and generation settings reflect roughly 2023, and modern reasoning systems may fail differently.
  1. Limitation 2: Annotations are grounded in the supplied source and do not separate source errors from model violations.
  1. Limitation 3: The four tasks are mainly English text and require revalidation for private, long-context, or multimodal RAG.

1. 局限1： 模型和生成设置来自 2023 年前后，现代推理模型的错误形态可能不同。
  1. 局限2： 标注以给定 RAG source 为依据，未区分 source 本身错误与模型违反 source。
  1. 局限3： 四类任务主要为英文文本，企业私有库、长上下文和多模态 RAG 需重新验证。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Use case 1: Train response-level and span-level RAG hallucination detectors and analyse errors by model, temperature, and task.
  1. Use case 2: Use quality and severity fields to filter training responses or provide local generation feedback.
  1. Use case 3: Before use on a new RAG stack, add current model/retriever outputs and measure transfer and source reliability.

1. 使用场景1： 可训练回答级与 span 级 RAG 幻觉检测器，并按模型、温度和任务分析错误。
  1. 使用场景2： 可用质量和严重度字段过滤训练回答或为生成模型提供局部反馈。
  1. 使用场景3： 在新 RAG 栈上使用前，应追加当前模型和检索器输出，测跨版本迁移和 source 可靠性。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: RAGTruth provides response-, word-, and severity-level human hallucination labels for real RAG outputs.
  2. Method: 2,965 sources, six-model multi-temperature generation, two-level annotation, and mitigation.
  3. Data: 17,790 responses, 7,664 hallucinatory responses, and 14,289 spans under MIT.
  4. Evidence: A small fine-tuned detector competes with prompt-based GPT-4 and reduces hallucinations.
  5. Reuse: Suitable for RAG verifiers; resample new models/retrievers and inspect source errors.

1. 一句话定位： RAGTruth 对真实 RAG 输出提供实例级、词级和严重度人工幻觉标注。
  2. 方法抓手： 2,965 sources、六模型多温度生成、双层人工标注和检测缓解。
  3. 数据抓手： 17,790 回答、7,664 幻觉回答、14,289 个 span，MIT 许可。
  4. 证据锚点： 小型微调检测器可与 prompt-based GPT-4 竞争并降低生成幻觉。
  5. 复用决定： 适合 RAG verifier；新模型与新检索器应补采样并检查 source 错误。
